title: Cylinders over null-measurable sets are null-measurable
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, Hᵏ := μHE[k] and π(y) := (y_1, …, y_P) for y ∈ ℝ^{P+1} (Lean: (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P+1)) ℝ y))). Assume (NT): for every N ⊆ ℝ^P with Hᵐ(N) = 0, H^{m+1}({y : π(y) ∈ N}) = 0. Then for every Hᵐ-null-measurable M ⊆ ℝ^P, the cylinder {y ∈ ℝ^{P+1} : π(y) ∈ M} is H^{m+1}-null-measurable.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ), (∀ N : Set (Eucl P), (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) N = 0 → (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (P + 1))) {y | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ N} = 0) → ∀ M : Set (Eucl P), NullMeasurableSet M (μHE[m] : Measure (Eucl P)) → NullMeasurableSet {y : Eucl (P + 1) | (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)) ∈ M} (μHE[m + 1] : Measure (Eucl (P + 1)))
